cases.assertion: A backend-only change skips experience-design atomic steps only when the approved requirements state no user-facing surface.
A missing approved renderer inserts support and returns to document rendering after readiness evidence.
A rerun upstream architecture decision invalidates implementation, review, performance, and release evidence.
A passing merge authorization does not activate deployment.
A canary threshold breach recommends rollback but cannot execute it.
Learning synthesis cannot persist a record without separate local-system authorization.
